# csv_content already loaded; use actual column names and handle \r\n
lines = csv_content.replace('\r\n', '\n').strip().split('\n')
header = [h.strip() for h in lines[0].split(',')]

target_reps = {"James Okafor", "Sofia Delgado"}
target_deals = {"D001", "D002", "D003", "D005", "D006", "D008"}

matching_rows = []
for line in lines[1:]:
    cols = [c.strip() for c in line.split(',')]
    row = dict(zip(header, cols))
    if row['rep_name'] in target_reps and row['deal_id'] in target_deals and row['status'] == 'won':
        matching_rows.append(row)

# Display results
total_amount = sum(int(r['amount']) for r in matching_rows)
print(f"Won Deals for James Okafor & Sofia Delgado (D001, D002, D003, D005, D006, D008)\n")
print(f"{'Deal ID':<10} {'Sales Rep':<20} {'Product':<28} {'Amount':>10} {'Close Date':<12}")
print("-" * 82)
for r in matching_rows:
    print(f"{r['deal_id']:<10} {r['rep_name']:<20} {r['product']:<28} ${int(r['amount']):>9,} {r['close_date']:<12}")
print("-" * 82)
print(f"{'TOTAL':<60} ${total_amount:>9,}")
print(f"\n{len(matching_rows)} deals found.")
